f(a=1,a=2)
$(Expr(:error, "keyword argument \"a\" repeated in call to \"f\""))
f(;a=1,a=2)
$(Expr(:error, "keyword argument \"a\" repeated in call to \"f\""))
f(a=1;a=2)
$(Expr(:error, "keyword argument \"a\" repeated in call to \"f\""))
struct S; x; x; end
$(Expr(:error, "duplicate field name: \"x\" is not unique"))
